summary: The render foundation: Forward+ on the desktop with gl_compatibility declared as the mobile fallback, a RenderProfile autoload that names the features the live method cannot do, one island WorldEnvironment resource and scene, a fixed isometric camera director, and a seven-shader material library the two procedural setpieces adopt in place of their flat StandardMaterial3D colours.

coordination.notes: Branched from origin/backend/b0-expedition-state at f5d26d1. game/project.godot is touched in three places only: the [rendering] block, one autoload appended at the END of [autoload], and a new [shader_globals] section appended at the end of the file (the foliage shader's global wind uniform the card names; nothing else in the repository declares shader globals, so the section is new rather than shared). P1 has not landed, so the capture loop used here is the existing game/tools/capture_review_scene.gd under Xvfb with Mesa software GL on --rendering-driver opengl3. Vulkan cannot run in this container (no lavapipe), so every Forward+-only effect in the environment is declared and unverified until P1's CI captures exist.
